subject: Rq004 mission shape
decision: Amended. Land the suite and the core spec repair are not epic on their own; they converge on one epic: simplify, improve and update the flightcrew core from the one-shot foundation. Decision mining and teams converge on another: make the cockpit self-sustaining and self-improving. Harness truth belongs inside the core mission. Order: fit out the cockpit (M001), then self-sustaining, then the flightcrew build-out.
